title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows, improve cache parallelism and deps hygiene
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: our GH Actions landscape grew organically over the last 3 years; many repos and packages use slightly different lint/test/release matrices which increases maintenance cost and causes intermittent cache misses that lengthen CI runtime. This PR consolidates and modernizes workflows across the monorepo: 1) unifies lint/test/release job templates into a shared .github/workflows/includes directory, 2) standardizes node/images to node20 + ubuntu-22.04 where possible, 3) collapses redundant job matrices (os/node combinations) and introduces dynamic matrix generation for smaller packages, 4) improves cache keys and parallelism to reduce cold-cache windows, 5) upgrades GH Actions and common action versions for security/hygiene, 6) fixes a flaky tests-by-label routing used by the perf-canary job. Motivation: shorter CI wall time, fewer config drift issues between services (sdk/python, sdk-ts, redwood), and easier rollback/override for release automation. This description includes the checklist, testing notes, and migration plan. Checklist: - [x] Move shared job templates to .github/workflows/_templates - [x] Add procedural docs to docs/dev/ci.md - [x] Update SDK repo references to new template inputs - [x] Run full CI across redwood/redwood-sdk-python/redwood-sdk-typescript - [x] Validate release automation still publishes when tag present Changeset summary: small-to-medium refactor across workflows, action version bumps, added caching semantics, and added a diagnostic flag for flaky test collection. Migration plan: Gradually flip new workflows using a feature flag input; old workflows kept for 2 weeks and then removed. Release notes: internal infra change, no product-facing impact. Related: ENG-2148 (CI unification), ENG-2199 (cache performance), SUP-4421 (support incident tracing flaky canary).
commits: Initial commit: introduce unified workflow templates and shared inputs
Upgrade: bump actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 across templates
Perf: improve cache keys and enable cache split by package + node-version
Fix: flaky perf-canary test routing (label-based shard)
Docs: add docs/dev/ci.md and migration notes
Chore: remove duplicate legacy workflow files (kept as guarded variants)
patch_snippets:
@@ .github/workflows/_templates/cache.yml
- uses: actions/cache@v3
- id: cache-node-modules
+ uses: actions/cache@v4
+ id: cache-node-modules
  with:
-   path: ~/.npm
-   key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}-{{ matrix.package }}
+   path: ~/.npm
+   key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ matrix.node-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}-${{ matrix.package }}
+   restore-keys: |
review_comments: Jordan Kim: Can we avoid introducing a hard node20 assumption for small legacy packages? Prefer matrix fallback to node18 if lockfile indicates it.
Aisha Patel: Added dynamic matrix generator; fallback to node18 preserved for packages with legacy lockfile. See job inputs 'node_fallback_versions'.
Lena Zhou: Cache key improvements look good but please add a 'ci:cache:clear' nightly job to avoid long-term bloat.
Aisha Patel: Added notes and a 'ci/maintenance/clear-cache.yml' lightweight job scheduled weekly in this PR.
Michael Hart: Please confirm release automation still signs artifacts and uses the same GPG key path in private deployments.
Aisha Patel: Verified signing flow against release-sandbox; no changes to key path were necessary — only workflow inputs changed.
Jordan Kim (approve): Approving once CI green and docs added.
Lena Zhou (approve): Approving after minor nits addressed.
testing_notes: Ran full CI across main monorepo on 2026-01-28 with the unified workflows enabled via 'ci_template=true' input
Observed 22% median wall clock reduction on lint+test jobs (sampled across sdk repos)
Cold-cache runs decreased from ~6 minutes to ~2.2 minutes on average due to improved restore-keys strategy
Perf-canary stability improved: flaky test routing fixed for labeled shard (reproduced locally and in staging)
migration_plan: Step 1: Enable unified workflows in main only for a subset of packages using 'ci_allowlist' input (1 day)
Step 2: Monitor CI times and cache hit ratio for 1 week (alerts added in console) (7 days)
Step 3: Flip allowlist to cover all packages, run clean-up to remove legacy guarded workflows (2-3 days)
Step 4: Remove legacy workflow guards after 14 days if no regressions observed
release_notes: Infra: CI workflows refactor and action upgrades. No product-facing changes. Expect faster CI runs and reduced maintenance burden.
notes_for_ops: If pipeline regressions observed, set workflow input 'ci_template=legacy' to revert to old behavior per-repo. Nightly cache clear job added under ci/maintenance/clear-cache.yml.
incident_links: SUP-4421: intermittent perf-canary failures during 2026-01-12 incident (trace included)
risk_and_rollout: Low risk: change is infra config only; most jobs reuse existing toolchains
Fallback: legacy guard workflows kept and toggled via inputs; can revert immediately by disabling template input
final_merge_comment: Squash-merged after green CI and approvals. Kept legacy guards for 14-day rollback window. Monitored cache metrics post-merge.
additional_context: This PR is part of the 2026 infra sprint to modernize CI and reduce developer wait time. It also prepares the ground for future Cloud Build integration and improved central observability of job-level metrics.
